sentences.text: Styrbord service Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-07 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
First sales and a first hire are recorded on 2026-08-07, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-13.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
